==Description==
'''Severing Connection''' is a foggy [[Maps|map]] that takes place in an in a half destroyed bridge between two islands. It is a map exclusive to [[Story Mode|Story]] mode.

==Design & Path==
'''Severing Connection''' is a large drawbridge placed between two islands. There are two main parts, the first being the road for cars and another being a rail track for trains. Plans are placed connecting the two bridges. One side of the bridge has visible smoking buildings. The bridge has a few fences on it which have been destroyed by cars slamming into them. These cars have since been abandoned on the bridge. A [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]], [[Humvee 3|Humvees]] and a [[Gunner APC]] can be found at the end of the main bridge, with the [[Gunner APC]] being there as part of a [[T.D.S. Organization]] [[Burning Bridges|rescue mission]]. Dynamite is placed all across the bridge to destroy it even further.

The path starts at one end of the bridge and ends at the [[Gunner APC]]. It takes turns every time the path is blocked by a barricade.

==Strategy==
*There are many u-turns on this map which are the ideal spots for towers here.
**The ones at the start are preferred due to them being closer to the entrance.
